setup: In an empty folder, copy evals/fixtures/base/, rename authoring/demo/SKILL.md.txt to SKILL.md, run git init and commit it, then copy evals/fixtures/two-files/ over it, renaming any SKILL.md.txt to SKILL.md, and leave the change unstaged
expected_behavior: Creates two commits: README.md alone, and app.py alone
Uses 📚 docs for the README.md commit and ✨ feat for the app.py commit, each subject in the form <emoji> <type>: <scope>: <summary>
Stages paths by name, never with git add . or git add -A
Leaves a clean working tree, pushes nothing, and reports each commit's hash and subject
